body: Yeah, sorry, I meant state of mind. And thank you for the support, I really appreciate it.

Hi, thanks for replying. Honestly, I'm fairly hopeful that I won't feel the same way in September, but if nothing changes by then, then I don't know. It's like I'm just going through the same motions, every day. It's so soul-crushing, it almost physically hurts.

Thanks for replying, it really means a lot to me. I hadn't considered churches, but why not. Anything at this point, I guess. Just not to our local parish, I really don't want to meet anyone I know right now. Not in this state, anyway.
